errors.text: The fracture-morphology assignment is reversed: the target associates HPHT-induced crack arrest with distributed or isolated microcracks rather than elongated interfacial cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis treats isolated microcracks as the brittle baseline signature and predicts elongated cracks or dimples after treatment.

The cited evidence does not directly demonstrate the specified 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 hour treatment, hierarchical transformation, or coherent FCC/B2 interfaces in Al0.7CoCrFeNi; it supports these claims only through analogy, and E1 explicitly limits applicability to systems containing brittle B2 phases.
